verdict: Organic is carrying all three locations; no paid engine is running.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, there was zero paid spend on Meta or Google Ads in the last 28 days — meaning all engagement came entirely from organic search and Google Business Profile activity. Combined, your three locations generated 401 GBP actions this period (90, 108, and 203 respectively), including 23 calls, 257 direction requests, and 121 website clicks. A Search Console spike at Forte Metals mid-period was encouraging, but all three locations show a hard drop in both GBP and organic search engagement in the last three days, suggesting a shared pullback in local demand. We're monitoring the GBP visibility across all listings closely and are in motion on reactivating paid channels to restore a consistent lead engine.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
paid spend across Meta and Google Ads this period — no paid leads were generated
week-over-week Search Console spike at Forte Metals, though momentum softened in the final three days

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement dropped to zero across all three locations in the last three days (Aug 15–17), and organic search clicks fell sharply at O'Hare Precision and Forte Metals in the same window.
watch_item.fix: GBP listing visibility is being reviewed across all entities, and paid campaign activation is being advanced to ensure a demand floor exists while organic recovers.
